concerns.text: The plan states that paired t‑tests will be run on the full test set *including proxy rows* (Phase 5), yet Feature Set B is defined to contain only rows where `is_proxy=False` (Phase 2). Model B therefore lacks residual‑stress values for proxy rows, making it impossible to evaluate it on those rows without either imputing proxy values or redefining Feature Set B. This inconsistency makes the claimed evaluation untestable and violates the requirement that every plan step be realizable with the defined data model.
